ir.name: all_pairs_diff_weight_tiebreak
ir.intuition: All pairs with tie-breaking using index order to ensure non-zero weight variation even when objectives are equal, increasing instance weight CV.
ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    batch_size, seq_len = objective.shape
    # Create mask including ties (<=) and exclude diagonal
    mask = objective[:, :, None] <= objective[:, None, :]
    eye = torch.eye(seq_len, device=objective.device).bool().unsqueeze(0)
    mask = mask & (~eye)
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    # Weight = absolute objective difference + small index-based term to break ties
    weight = (objective[b_idx, winner_idx] - objective[b_idx, loser_idx]).abs()
    idx_diff = (loser_idx - winner_idx).abs().float() * 1e-6
    weight = weight + idx_diff
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs_diff_weight_tiebreak'})

ir.name: loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage
ir.intuition: Shift from margin-based pairwise losses to a rank-gap based paradigm using the advantage signals and a smooth tanh link to penalize ranking errors proportionally to rank gap magnitude.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_gap = abs(advantage_gap)
scaled_gap = clamp(alpha * rank_gap, -10, 10)
loss_per_pair = relu(tanh(scaled_gap) - (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))
weighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_gap = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    scaled_gap = ops.clamp(alpha * adv_gap, -10.0, 10.0)
    link_val = ops.tanh(scaled_gap)
    diff_log_prob = lpw - lpl
    raw_loss = ops.relu(link_val - diff_log_prob)
    raw_loss = raw_loss * weight
    return ops.mean(raw_loss)
